national_news.title: MoU signed between Sports Ministry, Education Ministry, and UNESCO for Sports Values Toolkit
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Ministry of Education, and UNESCO exchanged a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to roll out the 'Sports Values in Every Classroom Toolkit'.
The toolkit features video modules that will be made available in 13 Indian languages to teach values such as respect, integrity, and fairness across classrooms.
The ceremony took place in the presence of Union Ministers Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya and Pralhad Joshi, alongside Dr. Tim Curtis, Director of UNESCO's Regional Office for South Asia.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet approves Container Manufacturing Scheme, PMVGSY, and Sports Goods Scheme
bullets: The Cabinet approved the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme with an outlay of Rs 10,000 crore for 13 years (up to FY 2039-40) to boost domestic container manufacturing.
Approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana (PMVGSY) as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme with Rs 7,395 crore outlay for 5 years (2026-27 to 2030-31) covering over 2.78 lakh Rural Local Bodies.
Approved the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme (Rs 1,856 crore outlay over 8 years) to create dedicated Sports Goods Manufacturing Zones (SGMZs).

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar to attend G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting and CHOGM
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S Jaishankar will attend the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting and a QUAD Foreign Ministers Meeting in Atlanta, US.

He will lead the Indian delegation to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) in Antigua and Barbuda, under the theme 'Accelerating Partnerships and Investment for a Prosperous Commonwealth'.
India will also host the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi from November 20 to 22, inviting all member states, dialogue partners, and observers.

national_news.title: PM Modi addresses Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the 3-day Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave spanning 12 thematic areas including AI, biotech, and ocean sciences.
Highlighted the achievement of the 500-Megawatt Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor achieving first criticality and mentioned that annual patent filings in India grew from under 50,000 to nearly 1.5 lakh.
Noted a Rs 12,000 crore government commitment matched equally by private investors for taking lab technologies to market readiness.

national_news.title: India to Amend National Anti-Doping Act to Introduce Criminal Provisions
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Mansukh Mandaviya announced that India will amend the National Anti-Doping Act to introduce criminal provisions for doping violations.
The criminal provisions aim to penalize coaches, support staff, and stakeholders involved in the supply chain of prohibited substances.
The announcement was made during the COP10 Bureau and Fund Approval Committee meetings under the UNESCO International Convention against Doping in Sport in New Delhi.

national_news.title: UAE President Honours Indian Pilot Captain Smit Machchhar with Order of Zayed II
bullets: UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan conferred the First Class Order of Zayed II, a top civilian award, on flydubai Captain Smit Machchhar and his crew.
The award recognizes their bravery and professionalism during an in-flight attack aboard flight FZ1073, safely diverting the plane to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
The honor was presented by UAE Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.

national_news.title: Mobile PLI Scheme Generates ₹25,000 Crore in Direct Taxes
bullets: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology highlighted that the Mobile Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme generated ₹25,000 crore in direct taxes and ₹3,000 crore in GST against an incentive payout of ₹19,000 crore.
The electronics manufacturing sector currently employs 25 lakh people, with mobile phone manufacturing alone accounting for 12 lakh jobs.
The Union Cabinet approved the Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (MPMS) with an outlay of ₹62,500 crore spanning FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31 to further boost domestic sourcing and R&D.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves 3% Increase in Dearness Allowance and Relief
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved an additional 3% instalment of Dearness Allowance (DA) for central government employees and Dearness Relief (DR) for pensioners, effective from July 1, 2026.
The decision will result in a combined annual financial impact of ₹10,016.10 crore on the national exchequer.
The increase benefits approximately 48.54 lakh central government employees and 68.71 lakh pensioners, adhering to the formula recommended by the 7th Central Pay Commission.

national_news.title: India Advances ₹38,000 Crore Greenfield Mega Shipyard Project in Thoothukudi
bullets: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal met HD Hyundai leadership in Seoul to advance the proposed ₹38,000 crore ($4 billion) greenfield mega shipyard at Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu.
The project is planned to have an annual capacity of 2.5 million Gross Tonnage (GT) and is expected to generate around 15,000 direct jobs once operational.
The initiative supports India's Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047, which targets an annual domestic shipbuilding output of 4.5 million GT by 2047.

national_news.title: India and Mexico Launch Talks for Preferential Trade Agreement
bullets: India and Mexico signed the Terms of Reference (ToR) to formally initiate negotiations for a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA).
The ToR was signed by India's Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal and Mexico's Undersecretary of Foreign Trade Luis Rosendo Gutiérrez Romano.
Targeted sectors for expanded cooperation include automobiles, pharmaceuticals, critical minerals, electronics, and energy, addressing a total bilateral trade volume of $7.83 billion in 2025-26.

national_news.title: India Positions Itself as a Key Future Exporter to China and ASEAN
bullets: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal stated during his official visit to the Netherlands that India aims to become a major exporter to China and the ASEAN region.
Bilateral trade between India and China grew by nearly 29% to $91.76 billion during April-September of the current financial year, positioning China as India's largest trading partner in H1.
India stressed reciprocal market access and commitment to fair trade, while raising concerns regarding Chinese export controls on critical machinery such as tunnel boring machines.

national_news.title: India and Liechtenstein Review Trade, Innovation, and TEPA Ties
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a bilateral meeting with the Acting Head of State of Liechtenstein, Hereditary Prince Alois, at Hyderabad House in New Delhi.
The leaders emphasized building momentum through the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA), focusing on trade, investment, technology, and innovation.
Prince Alois's official visit highlights growing economic engagement between India and the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) block.

national_news.title: 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum Concludes with Unanimous Joint Declaration
bullets: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum concluded in New Delhi under the chairship of Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, centered on the theme 'Fostering Parliaments for People-Centric Development'.
A unanimous Joint Declaration was adopted focusing on four core pillars: Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation, and Sustainability, alongside handing over the 2027 Chairship to China.

The declaration reaffirmed adherence to the UN Charter, condemned terrorism, advocated for ethical Artificial Intelligence, and called for due consideration of the Global South in global decision-making.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Holds Bilateral Talks with Liechtenstein Prince Alois
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held high-level bilateral talks in New Delhi with Acting Head of State of Liechtenstein, Hereditary Prince Alois.
Discussions focused on expanding trade, investment, science, technology, and innovation, leveraging the operationalization of the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement.
The visit included official meetings with President Droupadi Murmu and External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar to deepen bilateral ties.

national_news.title: Election Commission Defends Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in Supreme Court
bullets: The Election Commission of India (ECI) filed a 248-page affidavit before a Supreme Court bench led by CJI Surya Kant defending its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
ECI clarified that statutory Form 6 for voter registration was not altered and that the SIR declaration was an independent mapping document framed under Article 324 of the Constitution.
Citing Article 324(5), ECI affirmed constitutional protection for the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) against restraint and dismissed challenges concerning Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs).
national_news.exam_tag: Constitution Article 324 / Election Commission of India

national_news.title: PM Inaugurates ESTIC 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the three-day Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave (ESTIC 2026) at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
The conclave brings together scientists, policymakers, and industry leaders to deliberate across 12 thematic areas, including AI, biotechnology, healthcare, energy, and climate sciences.
Key highlights include an exhibition featuring 150 deep-tech startup stalls and the 'Global Connect Networking Event' to strengthen international research and industry-academia collaborations.

national_news.title: 9th Asian Champions Trophy Hockey Tournament Begins in Punjab
bullets: The 9th Hero Hockey Men’s Asian Champions Trophy 2026 commenced in Punjab, featuring six leading Asian hockey nations: India, Malaysia, China, Japan, South Korea, and Bangladesh.
The week-long tournament is being hosted at the renovated Olympian Surjit Hockey Stadium in Jalandhar and Olympian Balbir Singh Senior International Hockey Stadium in Mohali.
The final and semi-finals of the tournament will take place at the Mohali stadium.

national_news.title: 33rd India-Singapore Maritime Exercise SIMBEX-2026 Concludes in Visakhapatnam
bullets: The 33rd edition of the Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise (SIMBEX-2026), hosted by the Indian Navy, concluded in Visakhapatnam.
The exercise was conducted in two phases: a Harbour Phase at Visakhapatnam and a Sea Phase in the Bay of Bengal involving Anti-Submarine Warfare, Anti-Air Warfare, and cross-deck flying operations.
Key naval assets deployed included Singapore's RSS Supreme frigate and India's stealth frigate INS Nilgiri, ASW corvette INS Kamorta, and P-8I maritime patrol aircraft.

national_news.title: MoRTH Introduces Concessional Local Pass for National Highway Users Near Toll Plazas
bullets: The Ministry of Road Transport & Highways notified the National Highways Fee (Fifth Amendment) Rules, 2026, introducing a 'Concessional Local Pass' effective from November 1, 2026.

Eligible non-commercial vehicle owners residing within 20 km of a fee plaza with a functional FASTag can opt for an annual pass costing Rs. 1,500 (outside municipal limits) or Rs. 3,000 (within municipal limits).
The pass will be non-transferable, available via the Rajmargyatra App from December 1, 2026, and will not apply to closed user-fee systems or plazas with available service roads.

national_news.title: Integration of Waste Pickers under NAMASTE Scheme and Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment highlighted the social security coverage provided to informal sanitation workers and waste pickers under the NAMASTE Scheme.
Beneficiaries under the Waste Pickers component of the National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) are provided Ayushman Cards under PM-JAY for comprehensive healthcare coverage.
The initiative aims to eliminate direct human contact with hazardous waste and provide social protection, tertiary healthcare, and financial security to vulnerable sanitation workers.

national_news.title: Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 Organized at Dilli Haat by Social Justice Ministry
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment is organizing the fortnight-long Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 at Dilli Haat, New Delhi, from November 1 to 15, 2026, under the theme 'Prakash aur Parampara'.

For the first time, the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment and Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD) are jointly hosting the mela, bringing together Bharat TULIP and Purple Fest.

The event promotes economic empowerment for traditional artisans through Bharat TULIP (Traditional Artisans' Upliftment Livelihood Programme) and showcases inclusive participation for Persons with Disabilities.

national_news.title: Department of Telecommunications Achieves Key Governance Targets Under Special Campaign 4.0/6.0
bullets: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT), Ministry of Communications, reported key achievements under Special Campaign 4.0/6.0 coordinated by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG).
DoT successfully resolved 2,270 public grievances and disposed of all 640 pending public grievance appeals registered on the campaign dashboard.
The department generated ₹2.08 crore from scrap disposal and ₹2.18 crore from e-waste disposal while freeing 80,724 square feet of office space across 520 campaign sites.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Demands Water Security Revision Ahead of Indo-Bangladesh Ganga Treaty Renewal
bullets: The 1996 Ganga Water Sharing Treaty between India and Bangladesh expires in 2026, prompting Bihar to seek structural revisions to protect its agricultural and drinking water needs.

Under the 1996 treaty, water at Farakka Barrage during the lean period (January–June) is shared based on specific flow thresholds, guaranteeing Bangladesh up to 35,000 cusecs during peak lean periods.

Bihar representatives highlighted that despite the state possessing 16% of the Ganga's catchment area and feeding the river through 12 tributaries, it bears disproportionate burden to meet downstream treaty commitments.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Approves Raiyati Land Purchase Policy 2026 for Public Infrastructure
bullets: The Bihar government approved the 'Bihar Raiyati Land Purchase Policy 2026' to enable mutual-consent land acquisition for public infrastructure projects, offering higher financial incentives.

Landowners will receive compensation up to 4 times the circle/market rate in rural areas and 2 times in urban areas, an additional 10% incentive, and full exemption from stamp duty and registration fees.

Projects up to ₹100 crore will be approved by a District Magistrate-led committee, while projects exceeding ₹100 crore will be chaired by Divisional Commissioners; land pooling promises returning 55% of developed land.

bihar_news.title: ICAR-MGIFRI Motihari Launches Soil Health Program Under Khet Bachao Abhiyan
bullets: ICAR–Mahatma Gandhi Integrated Farming Research Institute (MGIFRI), Motihari, organized a soil health awareness program under 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan – Rabi 2026' in East Champaran, Bihar.
The initiative focuses on restoring soil health, balanced nutrient management, and developing climate-resilient farming techniques for flood-prone 'Chaur' (waterlogged) ecosystems.
Fields were categorized by water stagnation severity (3–5 days vs 13–15 days) to provide customized technical guidance for location-specific Rabi crop planning.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Delegation Studies Maharashtra's Panchayati Raj System in Nashik
bullets: A high-level delegation from Bihar's Panchayati Raj Department, led by Director Naveen Kumar Singh (IAS), visited the Nashik Zilla Parishad in Maharashtra.
The primary objective of the exposure visit was to conduct a comparative study on administrative structures, internal revenue generation, and financial empowerment of local self-government bodies.
Discussions centered on fund allocation processes, administrative-political coordination, and effective execution of development projects across Gram Panchayats and Zilla Parishads.

bihar_news.title: Gyan Bhadra's Book 'The Advent of a Statesman' on Bihar's Governance Released in Delhi
bullets: A new book titled 'The Advent of a Statesman: Bihar Has Never Had It So Good', authored by journalist Gyan Bhadra, was launched at the Press Club of India in New Delhi.
The publication was formally unveiled by Press Club of India President Sangeeta Barooah Pisharoty during a literature festival.
The book critically examines Bihar's development trajectory, governance challenges, agricultural distress, institutional capacity, and political leadership.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranks 9th Globally and 1st in Asia in World's 100 Best Museums List
bullets: Bihar Museum in Patna secured the 9th position in the 'World’s 100 Best Museums 2026' ranking released by global travel platform Worth a Journey.
The museum ranked 1st in Asia, making it the highest-ranked Asian institution and the only Indian museum featured in the top 100 global list.
Mexico City’s Museo Nacional de Antropología topped the global list, followed by Spain’s Museo del Prado (2nd) and Denmark’s Louisiana Museum of Modern Art (3rd).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Introduces Performance Assessment Index for Banks; Muzaffarpur Startup Innovates Corn Husk Utensils
bullets: The Bihar government introduced a 100-point performance assessment index to rank state banks; IDFC FIRST Bank topped the evaluation with 74 points.
As of September 30, 2026, Bihar achieved 38.25% (₹1.89 lakh crore) of its ₹4.95 lakh crore Annual Credit Plan target for 2026–27, with the state Credit-Deposit Ratio (CDR) standing at 60.17%.

Naz Ozair, an engineer from Muradpur in Muzaffarpur district, established MNO Swadeshi India Pvt. Ltd. and patented technology to convert discarded corn husks into single-use plastic utensil alternatives.
